question: Does a frozen pretrained CodeBrain EEGSSM representation align with the geometry and one-second change profiles of existing label-blind ear-EEG descriptors, and how sensitive is that representation to waveform controls?
scope: Exploratory methods comparison on previously exposed EESM23 waves. No new participant, session, raw dataset, learned codebook or pretrained generalization claim. No labels, history or identity enter numerical preprocessing or the encoder.

selection.rule: First 600 native seconds in 20 nonoverlapping blocks for each of the exact twelve Experiment008 files, regardless of outcomes. No replacement or extension for failed blocks. All are within the previously analyzed first four hours.

reserve: Do not open waveform payloads for participants007-010 or unexamined later sessions. All current inputs are already exposed.

encoder.name: CodeBrain EEGSSM backbone only
encoder.device: CPU float32, one torch/BLAS numerical thread
allowed_portability_changes: restore squeezed batch axis at external interface
encoder.spatial_limit: Pretrained on19scalp channels; learned ordinal convolution is unvalidated for four in-ear contacts. No invented scalp names or 3D coordinates.

preprocessing.filter: Per-block scipy fourth-order Butterworth bandpass0.3-75Hz, sosfiltfilt with10seconds reflected padding inside the30sblock; then60Hz IIR notch Q30 with the same pad length. No filter crosses block/gap boundaries.
preprocessing.resampling: scipy resample_poly up4 down5, default Kaiser beta5.0 antialias filter, constant padding, axis=time; exact6000samples.
preprocessing.scale: Known microvolt values divided by100; no fitted normalization, channel substitution, interpolation, imputation or reference change.
preprocessing.training_recipe_limit: Band and notch frequencies and uV/100 scale follow author sources; exact filtering implementation is an explicit engineering choice, not a claim of byte-identical pretraining preprocessing.

baseline.matching: Use original2s descriptors at native global centers block_start+1.5,2.5,...,28.5 seconds, standardized by frozen Experiment003 training center/IQR.

quality.rule: All predicates fixed before pretrained EEG outputs. Preserve all240candidate rows and every rejection reason. Same original-block support for all five waveform variants. Control-induced amplitude excursions are reported without changing the matched cohort. Gaps overlapping a block cause rejection.

representation.temporal_pooling: At each of30one-second patches, arithmetic mean across the four channel embeddings, then retain patch indices1..28 (centers1.5..28.5s). This describes a pooled vector and does not establish channel-order invariance.
representation.geometry: Within each eligible block, cosine-distance upper triangle among28encoder patch vectors versus RMS Euclidean-distance upper triangle among28standardized baseline vectors; Spearman rank correlation with average ties. Constant or zero-norm comparisons abstain explicitly.
representation.change_profile: Within a block only,27adjacent one-second steps between retained patch centers; encoder cosine distance between neighbors versus baseline RMS Euclidean distance between neighbors; Spearman correlation. Do not score between30sblocks. This tests change magnitudes at matched times, not validated discrete brain-state transitions.

inference.aggregation: Per-record median of valid block correlations, minimum3blocks; mean of two sessions per complete source participant; mean of complete participant means. Report every block and record, participant count and all six comparisons. No window-as-independent confidence interval.
inference.null: For geometry, cyclically roll one28patch distance matrix in both axes relative to the other (offset1..27). For change profiles, roll the27step encoder vector relative to the baseline (offset1..26). Precompute each nonzero shift perblock. Each replicate draws an independent nonzero shift pereligibleblock, then uses the exact same record/session/participant aggregation. These conditional cyclic-shift tests assume shift exchangeability within a block, which real nonstationary EEG may violate.
inference.multiplicity: Bonferroni across the six prespecified primary comparisons. Report raw and adjustedp with effect sizes. This is exploratory shared-structure evidence, not universal, clinical or semantic validation.

operations.channel_reverse: Reverse the four input channel positions; original natural order remains documented only in curator metadata.
operations.independent_phase: For each prepared30s channel, rFFT; independent uniform phases on interior bins; preserveDC and realNyquist; inverseFFT to6000samples; seed is9009+candidate_index. Per-channel Fourier magnitudes are conserved within float32tolerance; interchannel phase relations and local timing change.

controls.report: Using unchanged original eligible blocks, compare each variant with original encoder geometry (Spearman upper-triangle distances) and change profile (Spearman27step distances), plus RMS embedding displacement and preprocessed amplitude. Descriptive participant-balanced summaries only; no posthoc choice of best variant or formal invariance claim.

failure_policy: Retain failed candidates and runtime errors. No checkpoint substitution, dropped weight keys, model fitting, tuned thresholds or metadata invention. Test synthetic compatibility before EEG inference. Any scientific protocol change after freeze is a separately numbered amendment with reason and exposure timing; publish inconclusive/negative results.
